evidence.text:
Operating income in our North American operating segment increased $71.2 million to $ 271.3 million in 2013 from $ 200.1 million in 2012 primarily due to the items discussed above in the Consolidated Results of Operations. Operating income (loss) in other foreign countries and businesses decreased by $14.8 million to $ (6.2) million in 2013 from $ 8.6 million in 2012 primarily due to our continued investment to support our international expansion in our EMEA, Asia and Latin American operating segments. Investments in 2013 primarily include the opening of brand and factory house stores in China and offices and distribution facilities in Brazil and Chile, along with higher personnel costs and incentive compensation.
